messages.subject: gm.prcomp and 3 axes plot
parts:
Hi there,
with plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace I can specify "zaxis = 3" and to get the 3D plot with the first three PC on the three axes.
Using movie3d then, I can save a nice rotating .gif where the 3 principal components are visible.
plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace is deprecated but I'm not able to obtain such a 3D plot by using gm.prcom.
Have you any suggestion about it? I'm a beginner with R in general.
Many thanks in advance.
Sara Ferrando

Hi there,

with plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace I can specify "zaxis = 3" and to get the 3D plot with the first three PC on the three axes.

Using movie3d then, I can save a nice rotating .gif where the 3 principal components are visible.

plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace is deprecated but I'm not able to obtain such a 3D plot by using gm.prcom.

Have you any suggestion about it? I'm a beginner with R in general.

Many thanks in advance.

Sara Ferrando
